detailed_description: Color Blender creates a simple sequence of HEX colors between two selected colors. Choose the start and end colors with the browser color pickers or edit the HEX text fields, then set the number of intermediate steps from 1 to 20. The preview updates in the browser using linear RGB interpolation and shows each generated HEX value. Click an individual swatch to copy that color, or use Copy All to copy the full list of generated colors.
usage_steps: Choose the first color with the color picker or enter a HEX value.
Choose the second color with the color picker or enter a HEX value.
Set the number of intermediate steps between 1 and 20.
Review the generated color strip and HEX value grid.
Click a swatch to copy one color, or click Copy All to copy the full HEX list.
usage_examples: Create a short HEX ramp between a brand blue and an accent red.
Generate intermediate colors for a simple UI gradient mockup.
Copy a set of HEX values for a palette note or design handoff.
Compare how changing the step count affects the spacing between two colors.
